ticket.subject: How to avoid 429 errors
ticket.body_text:
Hi folks,

Writing on behalf of Ottervale Software. What are the API rate limits for our plan? Our sync stops halfway with 429 responses.

The job is blocked until we know how to pace it.

We would like this sorted before the end of the week. Please point me to the right page.

Cheers,
Jonas

label_notes: clean howto (howto-api-rate-limit): a how-to that blocks work is P3; urgency medium: action needed this week.
